gui.gamblingitems.rules.upgrader: Put one priced item in, choose the item you are playing for, and pull. The chance shown is the one the server draws on: the dearer the target, the smaller it is. A win gives the chosen item, a loss takes what was staked. The draw happens once, on the server.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.crash: Everyone bets in the same round, in any priced items. The multiplier climbs from 1.00x and the flight ends at a secret point drawn before the round. Cash out before it ends and you are paid your bet times the multiplier; wait too long and the bet is lost. The items staked come back on a win, the profit is paid in change.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.trade_up: Hand over the required number of items of similar value. The machine gives back one item drawn from a table built on what was put in, worth more or less than it. The odds and the rewards are printed in the window before you commit.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.case_opening: A case is opened with the key of its rarity, found on mobs. Each reward has a weight, shown as the chance of each line. The draw is made on the server once the case is opened; the reel only replays it.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.roulette: Prepare your chips, then click an area of the felt to put them there. A number pays 36 times the bet, a dozen or a column 3 times, red, black, odd, even, low and high 2 times. Zero belongs to no even money bet. The wheel only replays the pocket the server has drawn.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.case_battle: Several players join the same lobby and open the same cases at the same time. Each round is drawn for everybody; the best total when the last case is opened takes the whole table. Everything opened is priced from the same catalogue.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.blackjack: Beat the dealer without going over 21. An ace is one or eleven, a court card is ten. The dealer draws to sixteen and stands on seventeen. A win pays the bet twice, a blackjack pays it two and a half times, a push hands back the very items staked.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.bingo: Buy a card, then the drum draws numbers everyone shares. Your card marks itself as they come out; the free square in the middle is always marked. The first cards to fill a line share the pot. A card that has been paid for stays with the round until it settles.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.slot_machine: Prepare any priced items as credit and pull the lever. The three reels stop one after the other: three alike pay the line of that symbol, two alike pay 1.4 times the credit, anything else takes it. The items played come back on a win and only the profit is made up in change.
gui.gamblingitems.arena.description.cras: Cash out at the right time
gui.gamblingitems.no_contract_hint: Put items in the contract to see what you can win.

gui.gamblingitems.machine_next.high_stak: A higher target, reached less often
gui.gamblingitems.rules.lucky_wheel: Prepare any priced items as credit and spin. The wheel stops on one sector, drawn by the server before it turns. Each sector is as wide as its chance: the odds list gives every prize with its exact chance. A prize includes the stake: 1.5x gives back one and a half times what was played, 0.5x half of it, 0x nothing. Winnings below the stake are paid in change; above it, the credit stays and the profit is added. Played on the machine itself: hold a valued item (or chips) and press its control. Paid in arcade tickets, spent at the cashier's prize counter; when the server pays in items, winnings wait in the machine until you touch a control with an empty hand. Sneak and click elsewhere on the machine for its odds.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.coin_pusher: Prepare any priced items as credit and drop a coin. The plate pushes the shelf and some coins fall over the edge: how many is drawn by the server, with the chances in the odds list. What falls is paid as a share of the stake, from nothing to the top prize. Played on the machine itself: hold a valued item (or chips) and press its control. Paid in arcade tickets, spent at the cashier's prize counter; when the server pays in items, winnings wait in the machine until you touch a control with an empty hand. Sneak and click elsewhere on the machine for its odds.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.prize_claw: Prepare your credit, move the claw over a prize with the arrows or by clicking it in the list, then drop the claw. Each prize has its value and its grip: the chance that the claw holds it all the way to the chute. Heavier prizes slip more often. The server decides whether the claw holds before it moves. Played on the machine itself: hold a valued item (or chips) and press its control. Paid in arcade tickets, spent at the cashier's prize counter; when the server pays in items, winnings wait in the machine until you touch a control with an empty hand. Sneak and click elsewhere on the machine for its odds.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.pachinko: Prepare your credit and launch the ball. It falls through eight rows of pins, left or right at each with even chances, into one of nine pockets. The middle pockets are reached most often: 70 balls in 256 land in the very middle. Each pocket pays its multiplier of the stake. Played on the machine itself: hold a valued item (or chips) and press its control. Paid in arcade tickets, spent at the cashier's prize counter; when the server pays in items, winnings wait in the machine until you touch a control with an empty hand. Sneak and click elsewhere on the machine for its odds.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.capsule_gacha: Prepare your credit and turn the crank: one capsule comes out. Its colour is its rarity, drawn by the server with the chances in the odds list, and opening it shows the multiplier of the stake it pays. Played on the machine itself: hold a valued item (or chips) and press its control. Paid in arcade tickets, spent at the cashier's prize counter; when the server pays in items, winnings wait in the machine until you touch a control with an empty hand. Sneak and click elsewhere on the machine for its odds.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.high_stakes: Choose a target multiplier, then engage your credit. The target is reached with a chance of exactly one in the target (2x one time in two, 10x one time in ten): the green arc of the dial is that chance. Reaching it pays the target times the stake, less the house share shown under the odds. Missing it loses the stake. The smallest play is higher than elsewhere. Played on the machine itself: hold a valued item (or chips) and press its control. Paid in arcade tickets, spent at the cashier's prize counter; when the server pays in items, winnings wait in the machine until you touch a control with an empty hand. Sneak and click elsewhere on the machine for its odds.

gui.gamblingitems.rules.plinko: Drop a ball from the top of the giant board. It falls through twelve rows of pegs, left or right at each with even chances, into one of thirteen pockets: the edges pay the most and are the rarest. Played on the machine itself: hold a valued item (or chips) and press its control. Paid in arcade tickets, spent at the cashier's prize counter; when the server pays in items, winnings wait in the machine until you touch a control with an empty hand. Sneak and click elsewhere on the machine for its odds.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.big_six: Bet on one of the seven symbols, then the great wheel turns. Each symbol has as many slots as its weight: the rarer it is, the more it pays. The flapper at the top shows the winner. Played on the machine itself: hold a valued item (or chips) and press its control. Paid in arcade tickets, spent at the cashier's prize counter; when the server pays in items, winnings wait in the machine until you touch a control with an empty hand. Sneak and click elsewhere on the machine for its odds.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.video_poker: Jacks or better. Your stake deals five cards; hold the ones you keep and draw once. The final hand pays the line of the paytable on the belly of the machine, from a pair of jacks up to a royal flush. Played on the machine itself: hold a valued item (or chips) and press its control. Paid in arcade tickets, spent at the cashier's prize counter; when the server pays in items, winnings wait in the machine until you touch a control with an empty hand. Sneak and click elsewhere on the machine for its odds.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.horse_race: Bets stay open for a few seconds after the first one, for every player around the track. Then one race is run for all: the horse that wins pays its odds to everyone who backed it. Played on the machine itself: hold a valued item (or chips) and press its control. Paid in arcade tickets, spent at the cashier's prize counter; when the server pays in items, winnings wait in the machine until you touch a control with an empty hand. Sneak and click elsewhere on the machine for its odds.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.cashier: Put items of value in the tray to change them into casino chips at their catalogue value, or chips back into items. What is below the smallest chip comes back in change. Arcade tickets won on the machines buy the prizes of the counter.

gui.gamblingitems.rules.craps: The pass and don't pass lines of craps. The come-out roll wins the pass line on 7 or 11 and loses it on 2, 3 or 12; any other total is the point, and the dice roll until the point comes back (pass wins) or a 7 does (pass loses). Don't pass takes the other side, but a 12 on the come-out is barred: the stake is given back. Both pay even money.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.baccarat: Punto banco from an eight-deck shoe. Player and banker get two cards; tens and faces count 0, an ace 1, and only the last digit of the total counts. 8 or 9 is a natural. Otherwise the player draws on 0 to 5 and the banker follows the printed tableau. Player pays 1 to 1, banker 0.95 to 1, tie 8 to 1; on a tie, player and banker bets are given back.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.keno: Five spots: five numbers of 1 to 80 are picked for you, then twenty are drawn. The paytable pays by the number of your spots drawn.
gui.gamblingitems.rules.scratch_card: Each play buys a card of nine cells. Three cells with the same prize win that prize; stars never win.
gui.gamblingitems.vip_only: This machine is reserved for holders of a VIP card.
gui.gamblingitems.theme_set: The cabinet now has the %s look.
